mode.label: Quiet bot check on sign-in and checkout
mode.help: The customer never sees a puzzle or a box to tick. The page quietly tells the server how the form was filled in; a form that looks like a program, not a person, is written in the security log for staff. Nothing is ever refused because of it. Observe (the default) or Off.

minFillSeconds.label: Fastest a person fills a form (seconds)
minFillSeconds.help: A form sent faster than this counts as a sign of a program: the checkout, the customer sign-in and the staff sign-in each have their own number. 0 turns the sign off for that form.

weights.label: How much each sign counts
weights.help: Points each sign adds to the score (0 to 100; 0 ignores it): no signs sent at all (a script, not a page), the browser says it is run by automation, filled in too fast, no key, tap or mouse used.

noteScore.label: Write to the security log from this score
noteScore.help: A sign-in or an order whose score reaches this number is written in the security log. It is only a note: the order and the sign-in go through as usual.
